findings.evidence: Phase 2's final-message paragraph restates the terminal-versus-recoverable ordering, the warning wording, and the cleanup rule that phases 5 and 6 and the early-failure bootstrap already state, inside a 424-line command.
findings.fix: Move that paragraph's recoverable-fallback wording into the pr-diagrams skill this command's plugin bundles (skills/pr-diagrams/references/pr-body.md, beside Branch publish and attach recovery) and load it only on a fallback; leave in phase 2 the one rule that a stop before $AD exists skips cleanup.

findings.evidence: Phase 4 step 1 says any non-zero capability exit 'stops the run before render, as a failed related read does', but the same step says capability 'falls back to branch itself when gh is old or unprobeable', and pr-diagrams.sh does that with exit 0 and stdout branch; a probe that exits 1 with empty stdout has no resolved outcome.
findings.fix: Split the branch: exit 0 with stdout exactly branch, including the script's own old-gh or unprobeable fallback, selects branch mode and continues; only exit 2, or any other non-zero exit, or exit 0 with any other stdout, stops before render naming pr-diagrams.sh capability and quoting stderr.

findings.evidence: Phase 5's failure branch says a gh write that prints a PR URL is retried 'through the branch as the reference section says', while the partial-attach warning two sections earlier also allows publish to fail and the Mermaid body to be restored; the phase 5 branch itself names only the success outcome.
findings.fix: In that phase 5 bullet, state both outcomes the reference section already has: publish success replaces the image with the printed url, and publish failure restores the Mermaid fallback body with one gh pr edit, then reviewers.

findings.evidence: Section 1.1 restates the option grammar and the three bare aliases that section 1.2 and phase 1 already resolve, including the note that an alias 'starts with --, so [it] can never be a branch name'.
findings.fix: Keep the accepted tokens and the default once, in 1.2; point 1.1 at that list instead of repeating it.

findings.evidence: The Gotchas list states the bare 'gh pr view --repo' failure and the unexported ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} fact, then 1.4 and 1.5 restate both with the same consequence.
findings.fix: Leave the landmine and its why in Gotchas, and make 1.4 and 1.5 cite those two bullets instead of repeating them.

findings.evidence: Phase 4 step 1 offers attach and branch as modes capability may print, while the command's own default is only 'mermaid when the flag is absent'; nothing says which mode to expect when PR_DIAGRAMS_MODE is unset.
findings.fix: State that capability's printed word is the default, that PR_DIAGRAMS_MODE is the only override, and that the command never picks between attach and branch itself.
